data.text: Once per turn: a Shrine rises on the free (unoccupied) hex within 2 hexes that you pick; if you pick none (or it is not free), on a random free hex within 2 hexes. Whoever stands on a Shrine at the end of a turn (its 3rd action) heals 1 life, never above their maximum.

ability.note: resolved in simulate() (map geometry, occupancy, the move register) — not separable without changing behaviour
